mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.0% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime-specific conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals economic deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of UNRATE rise >0.3pp events or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0% indicate persistent inflation with restrictive policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through interaction effects.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns positive in >60% of triggered instances or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals supply constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days during high-inflation supply contraction regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns positive in >60% of INDPRO < 100 periods or Rank IC negative over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1300 indicate strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns not significantly positive when HOUST > 1300 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) declining >0.5% month-over-month signals weakening consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns positive in >60% of RSAFS decline >0.5% MoM events or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak labor growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% MoM) combined with high rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through interaction.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns positive in >60% of triggered instances or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, CPIAUCSL > 320 intensifies rate hikes, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as equity valuations face discount rate pressure.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns positive in >60% of tightening cycles with CPIAUCSL > 320 or Rank IC negative over 3-year window.
